notes:
Practice storage banquette with three independent seat lids. The center section was raised 2 inches and deepened 1 inch in one revision. The left section carries an earlier board order. Use a short framing offcut as a setup block or test cut before machining the finished parts.

Planning review — 3-section storage banquette
3 seating sections. Seating: 3 enclosed for storage, 3 opening lids, 0 with backs. Seat heights: 18, 20 in; depths: 24, 25 in. Closed body footprint in workspace X × Z: 72 × 25 in.
Assumption: This is an editable layout concept. Joinery, load capacity, bracing, anchoring, and finished tolerances still need design.
Assumption: Storage is enclosed with a bottom, front/rear and side panels. Panel joints and fasteners are not specified.
Assumption: Seat lids can be shown open for access review. The rear pivot is provisional; hinge selection, lid stays, pinch protection and wall clearance need design. Hinges and lid-support hardware are not specified or priced.
Assumption: The 3 sections are arranged side by side in one straight run; confirm whether you instead want an L or U layout.
Review: Confirm table clearance, finished seat height/depth, cushion thickness, and access before building.
Review: Seat lids are modeled; hinges, stays, pinch protection, wall clearance and attachment details still need design.
Review: Long unsupported members and missing bracing/fasteners need review; this layout does not establish safe loads.
